p: We Are Pet Friendly | Stay at our pet-friendly Virginia Beach Oceanfront hotel for an unforgettable getaway with your furry friends. Enjoy top-notch amenities and a prime location. From Memorial Day to Labor Day, dogs can be on the Boardwalk from 6 am to 7 pm and on certain beaches outside the resort area before 10 am and after 6 pm, always on a leash. The rest of the year, pets can enjoy the Boardwalk and beaches anytime. A leash is required on the Boardwalk and supervision is required if off-leash in the sand. Service animals are always welcome.
